{{RV|type=command

|game1= arma3
|version1= 1.44

|gr1= Diagnostic

|descr= Returns array with active SQSs. To see number of all scripts currently in the scheduler use [[diag_activeScripts]].

|s1= [[diag_activeSQSScripts]]

|r1= [[Array]] with [<nowiki/>[name, fileName, isRunning, currentLine],...]
* name: [[String]] - function or file name
* fileName: [[String]]
* isRunning: [[Boolean]]
* currentLine: [[Number]] - line currently executing

|x1= <sqf>{ systemChat str _x } forEach diag_activeSQSScripts;</sqf>

|seealso= [[diag_activeMissionFSMs]] [[diag_activeSQFScripts]] [[diag_log]] [[diag_fps]] [[diag_fpsmin]] [[diag_frameno]] [[diag_tickTime]] [[diag_activeScripts]]
}}
